title: Issue resolution status
summary: This topic centers on whether reported issues were actually resolved, with most fragments too brief or ambiguous to determine a clear sentiment and one explicitly negative request for compensation until a problem is fixed.

negative.summary: The negative feedback asks for compensation while an unresolved issue remains outstanding.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined fragments mention issues being sorted quickly, still not sorted, promised resolution without action, or expected future resolution, but they are too brief or context-limited for a firm sentiment label.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and very short, so the topic evidence is limited for drawing clear sentiment conclusions.
The examples focus narrowly on issue-resolution wording and do not provide enough context about the underlying problems or outcomes.
